abstract: The value of DNA cytometry for predicting the malignant potential of pure dysgerminomas of the ovary was investigated. Feulgen-thionin DNA image cytometry and propidium iodide DNA flow cytometry were performed in isolated nuclei from paraffin-embedded tissue of 25 dysgerminomas. Nineteen were in clinical stage Ia1, and six were in stage III (two in IIIa and four in IIIb). Eight patients showed recurrences during a 5-year follow-up period and one patient died of the disease. The DNA index (DI; the modal DNA value compared with that of normal cells) of the tumor cells was computed from the image and flow DNA histograms. Comparable DI values, ranging from 1.29 and 3.23, were found with both types of cytometry. No correlation was found with the clinical stage or the recurrence state. Furthermore, it was striking that, although values were found strongly deviating from the normal diploid content (DI = 1.0) suggesting an unfavorable prognosis, the survival rate was relatively high. It can be concluded that prediction of the clinical course of pure dysgerminomas by DNA cytometry does not seem feasible.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の純粋型ディスジャーミノーマ25例について、パラフィン包埋組織から単離した核を用いてFeulgen-チオニンDNA画像細胞計測とヨウ化プロピジウムDNAフローサイトメトリーを行った。臨床病期はIa1期が19例、III期が6例（IIIa期2例、IIIb期4例）であった。8例が5年間のフォローアップ期間中に再発し、1例が疾患により死亡した。腫瘍細胞のDNA指数（DI）は、画像およびフローのDNAヒストグラムから算出した。両方法で1.29〜3.23の値が得られた。臨床病期や再発状況との相関は認められなかった。正常二倍体（DI=1.0）から大きく逸脱する値は不良予後を示唆するにもかかわらず、生存率は比較的高かった。純粋型ディスジャーミノーマの臨床経過をDNA細胞計測で予測することは実現困難と考えられる。
